metrics.mask: t>=64ms and t+32ms<=N; exact16+10k-ms nominal target grid

acquisition_totals.note: Four conditions repeat each source; neither repeated samples nor frames are independent participants

conditional_uncertainty.scope: Conditional on the four selected speakers/two pairs; not a population interval
conditional_uncertainty.unit: prompt within pair, both sexes and all conditions together

metrics.limitation: Fixed 160-recording subset, four speakers/two prompt pairs; no population, calibration or clinical qualification.

natural.metrics_public_compaction: Only redundant all-empty reliability_bins with calibration_n=0 are omitted. All measured values, counts and nonempty bins are preserved. metrics_sha256 binds the complete local source.

preaccess_audit.independence: Four unseen speaker IDs in two matched prompt pairs. Prompt bootstrap is conditional on these four speakers; frames, conditions and matched-sex prompt repetitions are not independent people.
limits: No sealed content in the checked acquisition ledger, corpus paths or historical manifest scope; this is not an operating-system access log or proof of all external activity.
Public filename, speaker and prompt metadata were inspected before access; sealed acoustic/reference outcomes were not.
Corpus recording protocol, microphone setup and extraction procedure are shared with training. This is within-corpus unseen-speaker evidence, not an external cohort.
Reference extraction timing uncertainty remains; exact nominal scoring does not establish physiological alignment.
preaccess_audit.selection_algorithm: ascending SHA256 UTF8(20261022:integer_pair:prompt), then prompt ID; fixed count per speaker

independent_audit.limitation: Saved bytes, serialized command starts and completion timestamps corroborate the frozen phase guards; not an OS access log or network first-byte trace. Counts use the unchanged nominal provider reference, not manually established physiological truth. Prompt intervals condition on four speakers; no population, calibration or production qualification. No new inference or PCM transformation was performed.

execution.hardware: Apple M4 Max, 128 GiB unified memory
execution.scope: complete shared DSP+hybrid research path; not isolated inference cost
